meta.title: When Teachers Become Students · EduFest 2026
meta.description: 40 exclusive seats at EduFest 2026. Take the student's seat, master a brand-new topic alongside cutting-edge AI agents, and discover first-hand how agentic AI transforms teaching and learning.

hero.title: When Teachers Become Students
hero.titleAccent: Step Inside the Agentic AI Classroom
hero.subtitle: 40 exclusive seats at EduFest 2026. Take the student's seat, master a brand-new topic alongside cutting-edge AI agents, and discover first-hand how agentic AI transforms teaching and learning.
hero.venueValue: RMIT University Vietnam, Saigon South (SGS) Campus, 702 Nguyen Van Linh, Building 2

agenda.title: What happens in the room
agenda.subtitle: Most teachers sit as students. A few teach. Then everyone switches seats.

roles.title: Welcome and role cards
roles.body: Most of you become students. A few become teachers and teaching assistants.

lesson.title: Master something brand new
lesson.body: Tackle an unfamiliar topic live, with AI agents guiding you every step.

upskii.title: Build an AI lesson in minutes
upskii.body: Generate a lesson and quiz with AI on Upskii, then take it the way your students would.

practice.title: Practice, quiz and plus points
practice.body: Work alone and in pairs, then check understanding together.

debrief.title: Switch seats and debrief
debrief.body: Look at the class through the teacher's tools, and plan your own first lesson.

items.feel: Experience an agentic AI classroom first-hand, from the student’s seat.
items.when: Learn when an AI agent should give a hint, and when it should hold back.
items.plan: Leave with a ready-to-run plan for your own first agentic lesson.
items.look: Exclusive early access to cutting-edge AI agents for education, including what is still being built.

journey.title: Your seat, step by step
journey.subtitle: Walk through the workshop from the student's seat and back again.

arrive.title: Take a student's seat
arrive.body: You join a live class as a student. A few colleagues take the teacher and teaching assistant seats.

learn.title: Learn something new
learn.body: The topic is new to you on purpose, so you feel what your students feel.

stuck.title: Get stuck, get a hint
stuck.body: When you are stuck, the AI agent helps at the level your teacher chose: a hint, not the answer.

upskii.title: Try a lesson on Upskii
upskii.body: An AI-assisted lesson and quiz, made in minutes, taken from the student's side.

practise.title: Practise together
practise.body: Write by hand, code with a partner, and keep notes linked to your tasks.

check.title: Check what you learned
check.body: A short quiz on a timer, with plus points for taking part.

switch.title: Switch seats
switch.body: Back in the teacher's seat, you see how the class went, the fairness settings, and what the AI did.

aiDemo.title: How much should the AI agent help?
aiDemo.subtitle: The teacher decides for each class or session. AI is off by default.
aiDemo.note: A demonstration of the planned behaviour, not a live AI.
aiDemo.question: Solve 2x + 6 = 14.

off.label: Off
off.reply: AI help is off for this class. Ask your teacher or a teaching assistant.

hints.label: Hints, no answers
hints.reply: What could you do to both sides to leave 2x on its own? Try that first.

full.label: Full help
full.reply: Subtract 6 from both sides: 2x = 8. Divide both sides by 2: x = 4.

flow.title: One class, start to finish
flow.subtitle: What teachers and students use before, during and after class.

agents.title: Real AI agents, hands-on

early.title: Exclusive early access

experience.title: What you’ll experience
experience.subtitle: Moments from the session, in the seat you will be sitting in.

items.hint: You are stuck on a problem, and the AI agent asks you the question that unlocks it, without giving the answer away.
items.handwriting: You write a working by hand and watch it become neat text and maths.
items.quiz: You race a short quiz against the timer and earn plus points with your group.
items.build: You build a lesson and quiz with AI in minutes, then try it yourself.
items.insights: You see who joined in, where the class got stuck, and how the AI helped.

stuck.step2: Moving terms to the other side

insights.table: Show the data as a table

who.a: Teachers, teaching assistants and school leaders who want to see what AI agents can do in a real lesson. There are 40 seats.

skills.a: No. If you can use a laptop or phone for a video call, you can take part. Everything is guided.

ready.q: Is everything shown ready to use?
ready.a: Not all of it. Each capability is labelled Live, In progress or Planned from the public roadmap. Planned means not built yet.

answers.q: Will the AI simply give students the answers?
answers.a: Only if the teacher allows it. AI is off by default, and the teacher can choose hints only, with no direct answers.

registration.a: Registration is not open yet. Seats are limited to 40, and registration details will be announced here.

after.a: You leave with a plan for one lesson, using the capabilities that are live today.

illustration.label: Illustration: a teacher moves from the front desk to a student seat, while an AI agent supports every desk.
